# Spark compatibility

Status per surface. Anything not listed here is unknown and not supported.

## File formats

| Surface | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Parquet | supported |  |
| CSV | supported |  |
| JSON | supported |  |
| Text | supported |  |
| Avro | supported |  |
| ORC | not yet |  |

## Object stores

| Surface | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Amazon S3 and S3-compatible stores | supported |  |
| Google Cloud Storage | supported |  |
| Azure Blob Storage and ADLS Gen2 | supported |  |

## SQL

| Surface | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Queries (SELECT, joins, aggregates, window functions, set operations, CTEs) | partial | Measured by the Spark golden suite below. |
| Subqueries (scalar, IN, EXISTS, correlated) | partial | Common shapes are supported; remaining gaps appear as failures in the golden suite. |
| DDL and DML (CREATE/INSERT/DELETE on file-backed tables and views) | partial | Statements the golden suite covers are counted in its pass rates. |

## Spark Connect

| Surface | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spark Connect server (subset) | not yet |  |

| Surface | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rust UDFs | supported |  |

## Spark golden suite

Measured against Apache Spark v4.2.0's own SQL test files (19284 statements in 349 files).

| Check | Passed | Total | Rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Parse | 18796 | 18827 | 99.8% |
| Error class of negative cases | 3458 | 3857 | 89.6% |
| Result rows | 13674 | 15363 | 89.0% |
